name: open-infinite-canvas-bench
description: Playwright benchmarks and behaviour checks for open-infinite-canvas, with the naive baselines it is measured against.

scripts.bench: pnpm build:app && node scripts/run.cjs --variants engine,today,naive --sizes 100,300,1000 --repeats 2 && node scripts/compare.cjs
scripts.bench:quick: pnpm build:app && node scripts/run.cjs --variants engine --sizes 100,300,1000 --repeats 2 && node scripts/compare.cjs
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm build:app && pnpm build:app:react18 && playwright test
